# 100.00 USD owed on a receivable at 1.40, the split stating
# `cost_basis_brought_in: "1.00"`.
#
# The import records what a split brought in across zero itself, and passes a
# receivable over, so a key stated there would stay in the book and open a cost
# basis of 1.00 for the 100.00 owed. A file may not state it, on any split, and
# the transaction is refused.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: "Receivable"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2034-02-01 * "Consulting billed in US dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "140.00"
		cost_basis_brought_in: "1.00"
	Income:Consulting -140.00 CAD
